title: Transient CRISPR-Cas9 Coupled with Electroporation Protocol
author: Amy Gladfelter

steps.title: PCR Amplify CRISPR Components
steps.instruction: Amplify the CAS9, sgRNA, and construct DNA using the specified templates and primers.

substeps.instruction: Amplify CAS9 (6985 bp) using plasmid pXL1-CAS9-HYG as template with primers CAS9-F and CAS9-R.
Amplify U6pPromoter (~295 bp) using serotype D genomic DNA as template with primers U6P-F and GOI-sgRNA-R.
Amplify sgRNA scaffold (~108 bp) using pYF515 as template with primers GOI-sgRNA-F and sgRNA-R.
Amplify sgRNA construct (~383 bp) using the two previous PCR products as templates with primers U6P-F and sgRNA-R.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Mix
steps.instruction: Combine the construct, sgRNA, and CAS9 DNA in an Eppendorf tube.

substeps.instruction: Mix 2 µg construct DNA, 100 ng sgRNA, and 170 ng CAS9.
Note: A combination of 2 μg construct DNA, 1 μg CAS9 DNA, and 700 ng sgRNA can increase transformation efficiency.

steps.title: Purify and Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Vacuum dry the DNA mixture and elute in 5 µL DNAse/RNAse free water.

steps.title: Prepare Recipient Strain Culture
steps.instruction: Grow the recipient strain to the required cell density.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate recipient strain in 5 mL YPD liquid medium and culture overnight at 30 °C with shaking at 250 rpm.
Inoculate 100 mL fresh YPD medium with the overnight culture to an initial OD600=0.2.
Grow cells for 4 to 5 hours until OD600 reaches 0.6-1.0.
Keep all subsequent steps on ice and perform centrifugation at 4 °C.

steps.title: Harvest and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Collect and wash the cells using ice-cold buffers.

substeps.instruction: Collect cells by centrifugation at 3200g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Wash cells with ice-cold water (or EB Buffer).
Wash cells again with ice-cold water (or EB Buffer).

steps.title: Treat Cells with EB Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the cells for electroporation using EB buffer and DTT.

substeps.instruction: Suspend cells in 10 mL ice-cold EB buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.5, 1mM MgCl2, 270 mM Sucrose) containing 1mM DTT.
Incubate cells on ice for 1 hour (or 30 to 60 mins per 2015 paper).
Optional: Wash cells once with 10 mL ice-cold EB buffer.

steps.title: Concentrate Cells
steps.instruction: Collect the treated cells by centrifugation and resuspend in 250 µL EB buffer.

steps.title: Perform Electroporation
steps.instruction: Mix cells with DNA and apply the electrical pulse.

substeps.instruction: Mix 45 µL cells with 5 µL DNA mix (from step 2) in a pre-cooled 2 mm gap electroporation cuvette.
Electroporate using a BioRad gene pulser (0.45 kV, 125 μF, 600 Ω) or an Eppendorf multiporator (bacterial mode, V=2 kV, τ optimized for 5 ms).

steps.title: Recover and Plate Cells
steps.instruction: Allow cells to recover in medium before selection.

substeps.instruction: Suspend electroporated cells in 1 mL YPD medium.
Culture at 30 °C for 2 hours (or 1.5 hours per 2015 paper) before plating onto appropriate selective agar medium.
